description: This file defines the 'Affiliate' controller class for the account section in an OpenCart e-commerce system. It handles displaying the affiliate information page and processing form submissions to save affiliate data, including validation and interaction with models and views.

classes.name: Affiliate
classes.description: Controller class managing affiliate account functionalities such as displaying and saving affiliate info.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Displays the affiliate information page, preparing data and loading the view.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles AJAX form submission to save or update affiliate information with validation and redirects.
